pay_performance_pay_007_answer: VIEW evaluation uses a mandatory component (Demonstration of Student Growth through Value Added Measures or Student Learning Outcomes) and choice components across Exemplary Teaching Practice, Collaborative Leadership, and Extensions of Professionalism. STAR evaluation compares school-level student growth to Pennsylvania state rankings. PRC evaluation uses value-added modeling and measures student academic achievement, attendance, and course credits earned over a two-year cycle.
pay_performance_pay_007_evidence: VIEW: SECTION 1 *MANDATORY COMPONENT* Demonstration of Student Growth through Value Added Measures or Student Learning Outcomes... SECTION 2 *CHOICE COMPONENTS* EXEMPLARY TEACHING PRACTICE, COLLABORATIVE LEADERSHIP, EXTENSIONS OF PROFESSIONALISM. STAR: The annual growth in student achievement of PPS schools will be compared, by level, to the growth of schools in Pennsylvania as verified annually by the PA Department of Education. PRC: The bonus will use value-added modeling (VAM) of a team's contribution to student progress over the two (2) year looping cycle. The bonus will be based on better than expected results in student academic achievement, attendance and course credits earned.

evaluation_consequences_008_evidence: Career Ladder teachers must have a preponderance of proficient and distinguished performance in the fifth domain in order to continue, from one year to the next, in a Career Ladder Role. Career Ladder teachers not meeting this standard for continuance will be considered as displaced teachers in order to obtain a position for the subsequent school year. Any PRC teacher who receives an unsatisfactory rating will not be eligible to receive a cohort bonus and will not be allowed to continue as a member of a PRC team. The range of the VIEW Pay Program bonus will be up to a maximum of $8,000 per volunteer annually.
security_involuntary_transfer_005_eviden: Any additional openings are necessary to accommodate the placement of Career Ladder positions, they will be obtained through the offer of involuntary transfers for current teachers at the school (accepted in reverse building seniority order i.e., most senior first).
security_rif_006_evidence: Reductions in force within a high school will be specified as occurring within the PRC Career Ladder Corps or within the non-PRC teaching staff. System seniority shall be applied in the case of furloughs. Additionally, displaced career ladder teachers have a right to fill a vacancy as an involuntary transfer but may not cause an existing teacher to be displaced.
security_tenure_rules_010_evidence: For tenured teachers on internal steps of the salary schedule, step advancement will continue, and no portion of the earned bonuses would roll to the salary step.
safety_student_discipline_003_evidence: The LES will participate on school based teams (i.e. SAP/Core Teams, Discipline Committee) to ensure that TLE school based goals and objectives are being met. The LES will participate in training opportunities (during summer months if possible) to be up to date on current techniques in student behavior management and other related topics.
